Bash(git -C /Users/christopheralbert/git/cloudamp.app commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix Spotify position not being saved by interpolating between polls

PlaybackManager.getCurrentPosition\(\) returned lastKnownPosition which
was only updated by the CloudAmpService polling loop every 3 seconds.
For mobile-only usage \(no Android Auto\), the polling might not be
running at all, leaving the position at 0.

Add timestamp-based interpolation so getCurrentPosition\(\) estimates the
real position from elapsed time since the last update. Also set initial
position state on play, pause, stop, seek, and skip so the interpolation
works even without the polling loop.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
